name: chitty-1p-bridge
retirement_reason: 1Password is retired as a lane and as an authority; the cold source of truth is chittysecrets. op has zero accounts on chittyserv-dev, so op.get/op.list/op.otp cannot succeed. This manifest advertises NO tools so that centralized ch1tty dispatch never routes credential intent into the dead lane. Route credential intent through ch1tty -> ChittyConnect (/chico) instead.
